story: Until 2026-12-29 (32 days), options price DIXON to move about ±7.9%, roughly 12,037 to 14,089. In the past, the price ended inside the range priced this way 58% of the time.
Options are cheap compared with how much DIXON has actually been moving: they price 33.5% a year while the last month realised 51.4%.
DIXON has actually been moving about 3.24% a day this past month: very high for it against the past year.
Upside calls cost more than downside puts, which is unusual. Traders are paying up for a sharp move higher (this happens in squeezes and in stocks with a big pending event).

iv.simple: Options on DIXON are priced for moves of about 2.11% a day. That is on the low side for DIXON compared with the past year.
iv.analyst: 30-day constant-maturity ATM IV 33.5%: 29th percentile of 1 year, 22nd of all days since 2021-08-27.

vrp.simple: Options are cheap compared with how much DIXON has actually been moving: they price 33.5% a year while the last month realised 51.4%.
vrp.analyst: IV30 - RV21 = -17.9 vol points, 5th percentile of the past year. Since 2021-08-27, IV30 was above the volatility that actually followed over the next 21 sessions on 66% of days: option sellers are usually paid a premium for carrying the risk, and the gap is what that premium looks like today.

skew.simple: Upside calls cost more than downside puts, which is unusual. Traders are paying up for a sharp move higher (this happens in squeezes and in stocks with a big pending event).
skew.analyst: 25-delta risk reversal +1.25 vol pts (front month), 82nd percentile of the past year. More negative = more demand for downside insurance relative to upside.

realised.simple: DIXON has actually been moving about 3.24% a day this past month: very high for it against the past year.
realised.analyst: RV21 51.4% (91st percentile of the past year), RV5 42.6%, RV63 37.2%; RV5/RV63 compression at the 73rd percentile.

oi.simple: For the 2026-12-29 expiry, the biggest pile of call positions is at 14,000 (+6.6% away) and the biggest pile of put positions is at 13,000 (-1.1%). Option sellers defend these levels, so price often slows near them, but they shift as positions change.
oi.analyst: Front-expiry PCR (OI) 0.59; all-expiry OI PCR at the 45th percentile of the past year. Today's change: calls -228,600, puts -17,750 (OI units, i.e. shares or index quantity). A high PCR in India mostly reflects put writing, so it is read as crowding, not as a signal.

futures.simple: DIXON futures trade 82.0 points below the price itself. That premium works out to -7.1% a year, within its usual range for the past year.
futures.analyst: Near-month basis -82.0, annualised carry -7.1% (29th percentile of the past year; its 1-year median 0.5%). Last 5 sessions (price x OI, same contracts day to day): Short covering, Short covering, Short build-up, Short build-up, Short covering. Build-up labels describe what happened to positions; they do not say who is right.

move.simple: Until 2026-12-29 (32 days), options price DIXON to move about ±7.9%, roughly 12,037 to 14,089. In the past, the price ended inside the range priced this way 58% of the time.
move.analyst: ATM straddle / forward = 7.85% (forward 13,063.1). Scored on 1,299 days since 2021-08-27 against the official close on each expiry; a straddle is the market's mean absolute move, so about 57% inside is what a fair price would give.

notes.text: DIXON has used 31% of its market-wide position limit (the ban starts at 95%).
